title: InfoHeads
description: A refined block to command plugin
body:
![infoheads logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94c849b461a5bf775e39e2ad29c5cc5613dabf81_0.webp)
 InfoHeads is a plugin which allows you to assign commands / messages to be executed upon right click of a block. A truly great block to event solution!
![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d83bc1b64f4d86c8a5dc829f18f0272d5a3ce18.png)
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/qU11kvD8FyY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Main Features

- Click a block to display:
  - Messages! Send quick text to a user
  - Console Commands! Execute commands from the console.
  - Player Commands! Force players to execute a command.
  - Temporary Permissions! Don't give them op!
  - Cooldowns! Useful for daily rewards, quests and more!
  - Delay! Enable pauses between elements.
  - One-time Use! Restrict interactions to one per person.
- Click to teleport! Forgotten where the head has gone? Click to tp to its location.
- Threaded! This plugin uses asynchronous tasks, keeping your server TPS largely unaffected.
- Lightweight! Minimal impact on server performance.
- Placeholders Embed the interacting player name in commands and messages.
- Translatable!

# Permissions

    Infoheads.use: Allows usage for right-clicking head
    Infoheads.admin: Allows usage for the setup wizard

# Commands:

    /Infoheads wizard: Starts up wizard
    /Infoheads reload: Reloads config file.
    /Infoheads remove: Delete info head you're looking at.
    /Infoheads edit: Edit the infohead you're looking at.
    /Infoheads list: List the current infoheads that exist.
    /Infoheads help: Displays the help menu.

![dependencies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6dc38d9d12ff3160f7fc6305c47c0c9c1e0ce90d.png)
None required

This is a standalone plugin. This means the plugin works without any other plugin needing to be installed. However, you can install extra plugins for optional add-ons.

![extras](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7be4fa975f9d0edbd49cdf8b104250d8da295345.png)
Optional Installations

    More Placeholders! Install PlaceholderAPI. Then use their available placeholders.
